briefings.title: How to navigate a crisis: lessons from a chief investment officer

people.name: Yves Bonzon
people.role: Group Chief Investment Officer, Julius Baer

briefings.tldr: Successfully navigating market crises requires distinguishing between unpredictable exogenous shocks and systemic endogenous failures, maintaining rigorous rational discipline over emotional behavioral biases, and retaining the portfolio flexibility to pivot quickly when initial assumptions prove wrong.
